title: [CQ-C10] Targeted context guidance
description:
Objective: Update role/skill source guidance and prompt transports to reuse supplied verified references and expand only when needed.

Deliverable: Targeted context guidance. This is task C10 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): npm run lint

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): C06, C09.
definitionOfDone: Stable role prefix remains separate from dynamic packets.
Mandatory broad rereads do not negate packet benefit.
Role docs remain within line cap; bundled source sync remains generated.
Fresh verification `npm run lint` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.

2. Overlay ONLY this task's files.
3. Symlink a native packages/moe-daemon/node_modules, after checking that package-lock.json is equal modulo CR.
4. Run under env -i with the nvm node bin on PATH and NO_COLOR=1: `npx vitest run src/util/targetedContextGuidance.test.ts`.

If G6 fails on today's docs, report the offending line in the note; never weaken the check to make it pass.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Mandatory broad rereads found (DoD2):
(a) worker.reference.md:105 and architect.reference.md:89 say 'On task start, list_memories'. On this 560-plus memory store that is a large listing the launcher's memory inventory (memory_this_task / memory_recent) makes unnecessary. worker.md:27 is already inventory-first.
(b) Repeated skill-body reloads inside one session. complete_step recommends test-driven-development for EVERY test-touching next step (completeStep.ts isTestStep), and get_context recommends moe-planning for every PLANNING task an interactive architect claims. The role docs say to load the recommendedSkill before the hinted tool, and the reference red-flag rows say 'Skills evolve. Read the current version.', so the same body reloads again and again.
(c) explore-before-assume makes a worker re-grep symbols the approved plan already verified. The skill itself tells architects to bake verified names into steps 'so the worker doesn't re-derive them'.
(d) 'Stale' is undefined in the transport text, which invites defensive full re-fetches.

Stable prefix (DoD1):
- bash: SYSTEM_APPEND = role line + tool naming + approval mode + the role doc from load_role_doc. The role doc is read from .moe/roles/<role>.md, falling back to docs/roles.
- ps1: $systemAppendPre + Get-RoleDoc.
- The per-task part is DYNAMIC_CONTEXT / $dynamicContext: claimed_task_context, inbox, pending questions, the skill JIT reminder and mentions.
- Today's tests pin the boundary only for Codex (both engines) and Claude on ps1, each with a literal stand-in prefix. None runs the real prefix assembly with a real role doc.

Role docs reach IDE users only through the generated bundle: initFiles.ts ROLE_DOCS, which includes *.reference.md, and skillFiles.ts SKILL_FILES. A doc-only edit is inert until regenerated.

The PS 5.1 Get-RoleDoc read (Get-Content -Raw, no -Encoding) garbles BOM-less UTF-8 role docs. Verified on this machine with PS 5.1.26100; tracked as task-5dc76be6.

Interfaces this plan relies on:
- Landed: the C01 packetManifest statuses (served, truncated, omitted, missing), its limitations and the 'no-repository-source' code; F06 servedContext; the CQ-01 directive strings; the inbox memory keys.
- NOT landed: the C04/C05/C06/C07 agent-facing contracts. Handled by the step 2 adaptation rule.
- C09 is not consumed: file-disjoint, and recipes have no agent-facing activation per C08. Its edge is kept under the plan-don't-park directive, so a governor may relax it.
